subject.title: [Feature]: Detect Containerized Environments and Disable Update Suggestions

question: Should detected containers automatically suppress explicit update.auto.enabled and every local update action, or should existing explicit auto-update behavior remain until a documented container update policy is approved?
rationale: The PR changes a stored operator setting and leaves other local update actions available, so automation cannot choose the permanent product policy safely.

options.title: Complete Container Update Policy
options.body: Gate or replace all local update actions in detected containers, document the auto-update decision, and require upgrade/live proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Automatic Suppression
options.body: Maintain the current PR direction and intentionally make detected containers ignore update availability and explicit auto-update settings, with docs and tests added before landing.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep the PR paused or close it until maintainers decide the broader container update behavior on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Complete Container Update Policy
recommendation.body: Gate or replace all local update actions in detected containers, document the auto-update decision, and require upgrade/live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the update availability/status history and committed the UI update banner change, making him the strongest owner for the update policy choice.
